description: Turn an idea into a small working prototype
leadGuide: Define the thinnest working version: one main flow, simple structure, a README and a few tests. List what is deliberately left out.
engineerGuide: Build the smallest working version of the idea with a clear structure, a README explaining how to run it, and tests for the main flow. Prefer the standard library over new dependencies. Make sure the project's checks pass.
reviewRubric: Does the main flow work end to end? Is the structure easy to extend? Is the README enough for a new developer to run it? Is anything over-built for a prototype?
